products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-AUDIO-Board
products.summary: 16MiB Flash / 8MiB PSRAM。双麦克风、扬声器、七颗RGB；TCA9555三键与codec控制寄存器、RTC、原生SD数字子集。

interfaces.name: TF · native1-bit SDMMC
interfaces.notes: 默认64MiB FAT32；已测实际客体1bit SDMMC DMA512字节读写、错路由和拔卡；不把它等同原厂完整FAT挂载。

limitations: ES8311/ES7210 control register endpoints only; microphone capture, PCM playback, voice recognition, camera/display options and cloud services are not implemented.
Three keys are TCA9555 inputs P11/P12/P13 (linear9/10/11). Seven RGB chain positions have not been mapped to native3D parts.
SKU32184 includes native1000mAh battery. SKU32185/EN excludes it; battery/charging/RTC-backup electrical physics remain unmodeled.
Source-bounded digital subset only. Original factory execution, browser/WebGL and physical hardware acceptance are separate; no complete compatibility claim.
No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
Exact32184 includes1000mAh battery; exact32185/EN omits only identified native battery component2. Both retain native speaker/case/PCB. No optional screen/camera is invented.
Native PMMA/case/speaker/battery/internal topology preserved unscaled; colors and optical transparency are visualization approximations.
Seven RGB outputs and three expander buttons work in the digital runtime; native LED/button identities have not been calibrated as live3D markers or ray-hit regions.
Shared native case base label mentions TOUCH-LCD-1_85; this exact AUDIO SKU has no included display. Native mechanical source is not evidence of LCD compatibility.

Native battery component2 has a conservative analytic Y bound 0.226499mm beyond mesh vertices at three independently Clean/remeshed densities. SHA-bound 0.23mm export check exception applies only to that battery; geometry remains unscaled and every other component retains0.05mm export tolerance. This is not a hardware fit tolerance.

chronology.notes: 公开发布日期未核实；店面位置仅为处理次序，固件日期不作为硬件发布日期。
